cc:Work.dc:title: SGD：Warmup + Linear Decay
cc:Work.dc:description: SGD schedule with a prescribed illustrative 5% warmup, normalized peak 1, and linear decay to zero. Both axes are linear. The decay-bound assumptions are convex objectives, unbiased gradients, and a common constant gradient-energy bound; warmup length and peak are not jointly optimized.
